description: This file defines an interface 'ICallChainReentrantGrainContext' that includes methods for managing reentrant sections within a grain in Orleans runtime, allowing requests with the same reentrancy ID to re-enter the grain code.

classes.name: ICallChainReentrantGrainContext
classes.description: Interface providing methods to mark entry and exit points for reentrant sections within a grain, facilitating reentrant request handling based on reentrancy IDs.

methods.name: OnEnterReentrantSection
methods.description: Marks the start of a reentrant section within a grain, allowing requests with the same ReentrancyId to re-enter.

methods.name: OnExitReentrantSection
methods.description: Marks the end of a reentrant section within a grain, ending the reentrancy allowance for requests with the same ReentrancyId.
